subject: [PATCH v3 3/7] sched/numa: scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David suggested a minor code reorganization for better readability, specifically moving two conditions related to placement scans into a single variable and then using that variable in the if statement.

2026-09-25.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) balancing code to scan read-only file mappings when tiering is enabled, but only for promotion purposes. This change prevents hot file folios on slow memory from being promoted and ensures that shared library pages are not migrated unless it would be beneficial. The patch also updates the task_numa_work function to build protection flags for each VMA based on a snapshot of the balancing mode, ensuring consistency in PTE and PMD paths during scanning. This change addresses an issue where a binary's tier residency was not tracking its runtime hotness correctly.
